name: Prof Ada Cheung
title: Professor / Endocrinologist
practice: Private rooms at North Eastern Urology
description: Leading endocrinologist and researcher on the effects of testosterone and oestrogen and on improving health outcomes for trans and gender diverse individuals; Associate Editor of the International Journal of Transgender Health and GLOBE LGBTIQ Ally of the Year 2021. Consults face-to-face and by video, with telehealth Australia-wide. GP referral required; waitlist of several months and intermittently closed.
specialties: Gender affirming hormone therapy, trans health research, general endocrinology, androgen deprivation therapy

name: Dr Ingrid Bretherton
title: Dr / Endocrinologist
description: Endocrinologist and founder of Inner North Endocrinology with a special interest in transgender health; her PhD studied the effects of hormone therapy on bone health, body composition and quality of life in gender diverse Australians. The practice offers consultations to gender diverse adults wanting to discuss gender affirming hormone therapy (not under 18). Private billing; referral needed.
specialties: Gender affirming hormone therapy, transgender health, bone health, general adult endocrinology

name: Prof Jeffrey Zajac
title: Professor / Endocrinologist
description: Endocrinologist with 35 years' experience, former Director of Endocrinology at Austin Hospital and Professor of Medicine at the University of Melbourne; lists Transgender and Intersex Health among clinical interests. The practice provides masculinising and feminising hormone therapy for trans people. Specialist referral required.
specialties: Transgender and intersex health, gender affirming hormone therapy, andrology, general endocrinology

name: Dr Nicholas Russell
title: Dr / Endocrinologist
description: Endocrinologist and general physician (Austin Health) with a PhD in andrology, who invites referrals in all aspects of endocrinology including transgender care. Referral required.
specialties: Transgender care, andrology, endocrinology, diabetes, obesity management
